Name: Prismatic Statue (Speed up machines)
Author: Achtuur8
Description:
[b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b]

Do you want to upgrade your machines? Do you feel like your machines are just a tad bit too slow? Do you have enough prismatic shards laying around?
Well then, this is the mod for you! This mod introduces the [i]Prismatic Statue[/i], this statue lets you speedup all adjacent machines in the same group.
[b]Requires [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url][b] and [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url][b].

[b][size=5]What does the statue do?[/size][/b]
[/b]
When placing a statue adjacent to at least 1 chest and 1 machine (furnace, keg, preserves jar etc.), it will speed up the machine when it is processing. Each statue will speedup [b]every[/b] machine in the same group. Multiple statues stack, up to a certain maximum that can be configured in the config. By default, it takes three statues to roughly halve the processing time of all connected machines. The configuration menu contains a table showing the effect of statues.

[b]How do I know it's working?[/b]

By pressing 'L' (configurable in the config), you will see an overlay showing which machines are affected. If the statues have a rainbow tile, chests have a white tile, and machines have a magenta tile, then it's working! 

[b][size=5]How do you get the statue?
[/size][/b]
[s]After completing the community center and having 6 hearts with [b]both[/b] Robin and the Wizard, you will get a letter from Robin saying she has a new device. Then, the recipe for the Prismatic Statue is available at Robin's shop for 50000 gold. [/s] (Old method broke due to Mailframework mod being broken at the time of writing)

You unlock the statue when you reach mining level 9.

To craft a Prismatic Statue you will need:
[list]
[*]1 Prismatic Shard
[*]10 Iridium bars
[*]5 Battery packs
[*]5 Solar essence
[*]5 Void essence
[/list]
[b][size=5]Compatibility
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Machines added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url], provided you also have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFMAutomate[/url].
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7411]Combine Machines[/url]﻿﻿
[/list]
[b][size=5]Features[/size][/b][list]
[*]Adds in the [i]Prismatic Statue[/i]
[list]
[*]Speeds up machines in the same machine group
[*]Recipe purchasable from Robin, after earning 6 friendship hearts with Robin, the Wizard and completing the community center
[*]Multiple statues stack, with diminishing returns and up to a certain maximum.
[/list][*]Overlay showing the machines currently sped up
[list]
[*]Toggle overlay with L﻿
 (can be changed in config)[*]Legend:[list]
[*]Rainbow: [i]Prismatic Statues[/i]
[*]Magenta: Machines that are sped up & processing something
[*]Purple: Machines that are sped up, but not processing anything currently
[*]White: Objects in the same group as the statue, but not affected
[/list]
[/list][*]Speedup and max statues are configurable.
[list]
[*]Config menu contains a section that lets you see the effects of the speedup. Use this to configure the speed settings you want.
[/list][/list]
[b][size=5]Important[/size]
[/b]
Very big thanks to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/52800236-brightonmorris1/]Brightonmorris1[/url] for providing this mod with the animated sprite for the statue!

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16827]AchtuurCore[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url].﻿﻿﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder.
[/list]
